description: Maps a section's (implementationPolicy.pattern, implementationPolicy.defaultImplementation) tuple to the npm packages the implementing agent must install before authoring the section. Also lists devDependencies needed by verify-section-preview modes. Read by scripts/inspect/inspect-bootstrap.mjs to compute sectionRuntimeDepsInstalled. Adding a new pattern/implementation pair only requires editing this file — section skills do not need to be rewritten.

carousel/swiper.rationale: skills/theme/swiper-carousel/SKILL.md depends on Swiper v11 APIs (modular module imports, slideToLoop, swiper/css path).

carousel/scroll-snap.rationale: Pure CSS scroll-snap pattern; no runtime npm dependency.

static/none.rationale: Static section; no runtime npm dependency.

storefront-render.rationale: scripts/agent/verify-section-preview.mjs uses the playwright already required by the offline path; no extra dep when going through storefront-render.

offline.rationale: scripts/agent/verify-section-preview-offline.mjs drives playwright against a static HTML snapshot. Chromium is not bundled with the harness package.
